articles.originalTitle: Scientists finally solved how a common gut bacterium triggers colon cancer
articles.excerpt: Researchers solved a long-standing mystery behind how a bacterial toxin associated with colorectal cancer damages the colon. The discovery could pave the way for new therapies to prevent inflammation and colon tumors.
